content.comment_body: Hello, I am currently working on a window roller shutter project using the latest [product_name] [version_no] [article_no]. For some reason, the display on the device started flashing the time, and there is a flashing socket symbol in the top right of the screen. Previously, I was working with the [product_name] web editor before this happened. Since then, I have lost access to the web server; it appears unresponsive. There is no error message—the device continues to run the project, but the web server does not respond. I tried a factory reset, but it didn't resolve the issue. I haven't found any relevant [document] explaining the situation. Thank you.

A flashing time on the display typically means the device has lost its time settings. I haven't seen a socket symbol on this device before. Is your power supply stable? Consider taking a photo for reference. Which web server software are you using? If there's an SD card inserted in the device, have you tried removing it first?

analysis.insight_summary: The user faces an issue where the web server of the [product_name] [version_no] module becomes inaccessible after interacting with the [product_name] web editor. The device shows unclear visual signals, like a flashing time and socket symbol, and standard troubleshooting such as a factory reset does not restore web server functionality. The absence of documentation increases the user's difficulty in resolving the problem.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects stable access to the web server, meaningful and documented device indicators, and comprehensive troubleshooting instructions available in official documentation.
